website.note: Pipeline shows DURAVYU (EYP-1901) in Phase 3 for wet AMD (LUGANO, LUCIA) and Phase 3 for DME (COMO, CAPRI).

ctgov.note: Four active Phase 3 studies of EYP-1901 (DURAVYU); other historical trials are completed/terminated/withdrawn.

pipeline.modality: Sustained-release intravitreal insert (Durasert E bio-erodible polymer) delivering vorolanib
pipeline.target: Multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor (VEGF receptors, PDGFR)
pipeline.license_origin: Vorolanib in-licensed from Equinox Sciences/Tyrogenex; Durasert technology proprietary to EyePoint

indications.trial_design: 2-year randomized, double-masked, active-controlled (vs aflibercept 2.0 mg) studies in previously treated wAMD patients; primary endpoint at Week 56
key_milestones: Week 56 primary efficacy readout expected from primary completion dates 2026-08 (LUGANO) and 2026-10 (LUCIA)

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-masked Phase 3 studies comparing EYP-1901 vs aflibercept 2.0 mg in DME patients
key_milestones: Study start February 2026; primary completion expected October 2027

commercial_product.YUTIQ: Fluocinolone acetonide intravitreal insert for chronic non-infectious uveitis (FDA approved 2018); U.S. commercial rights divested to Alimera Sciences in 2023.
commercial_product.DEXYCU: Dexamethasone intraocular suspension for postoperative inflammation following ocular surgery (FDA approved 2018); subject to DOJ investigation.

excluded_preclinical.description: Razuprotafib (Tie2 activator) formulated in Durasert E for serious retinal diseases; advancing into pre-clinical development per 10-K.
